name: Shakti Sadan
department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
target_group: Women in difficult circumstances who need shelter and rehabilitation support
eligibility: Admission is based on the applicable Mission Shakti/Shakti Sadan guidelines and assessment.
benefits: Shelter, food, clothing, counselling, health/legal assistance, skill development and rehabilitation support as applicable.
application_process: Approach the nearest Shakti Sadan/concerned district authority for assessment and admission.
source: Ministry of Women and Child Development / Government of India
